en.archiveTitle: Daily Brief | The Blood of Dawnwalker Sells One Million Copies in 48 Hours

entries.headline: Sid Meier's Civilization VII reveals its first expansion, EARTHRISE
entries.summary: 2K announced EARTHRISE, the first expansion for Sid Meier's Civilization VII. The space-themed expansion introduces celestial mapping in the Antiquity and Exploration Ages and solar-system missions in later eras.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON published the report at 01:17 UTC on September 6, within the fixed evidence window.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report relays 2K's announcement and supports the expansion name, first-expansion status, and space theme. The packet lacks a separately opened primary URL, so this is classified as a media relay of official news.

entries.headline: Ammossum launches on Steam on September 29 in Japan
entries.summary: Yahaha Games announced that West Glade's Ammossum will launch on Steam on September 28 locally, corresponding to September 29 in Japan. The ammunition-building action game combines deckbuilding and tower-defense elements, with a demo available on itch.io.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON published the report at 06:09 UTC on September 5, within the fixed evidence window.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report relays the publisher's announcement and supports the developer, local and Japanese dates, Steam platform, and demo availability.

entries.headline: Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic and its classic recreation will launch as separate apps
entries.summary: Shanghai Alice Reprise representative JYUNYA says Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic and the original-style Touhou Koumakyou: Classic will be released as separate applications. Buying New Classic grants Classic at no extra charge. New Classic is due September 10 for PS5, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and Steam.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON published the report at 23:47 UTC on September 5, within the fixed evidence window.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report relays the project representative's announcement and supports the two-app structure, purchase entitlement, date, and platforms.

entries.headline: The Blood of Dawnwalker sells one million copies in 48 hours
entries.summary: Bandai Namco and Rebel Wolves announced that The Blood of Dawnwalker sold more than one million copies within 48 hours of launch. The game launched September 3 for PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S.
entries.timeNote: IGN published the report at 17:30 UTC on September 5, within the fixed evidence window.
entries.verification: The opened IGN report cites the developer's official celebratory post and supports the one-million figure, 48-hour window, and launch platforms. The packet lacks a separately opened primary URL, so this is treated as a media relay of official news.

entries.headline: Dungeon Settlers enters Steam Early Access with a peak near 3,000 concurrent players
entries.summary: Dungeon Settlers has launched in Steam Early Access. AUTOMATON reports a peak of roughly 3,000 concurrent players and an 87% positive rating across about 170 user reviews, while describing its mix of colony management and procedurally generated dungeon exploration.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON published the report at 08:13 UTC on September 5, within the fixed evidence window.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report supports the Early Access launch, platform, and the reported concurrent-player and user-review figures. The figures are presented as time-specific media observations.

entries.headline: The Tetris Company denies involvement in the White House's Build the Wall game
entries.summary: The Tetris Company says it was not involved in creating the White House's Build the Wall game and that it takes copyright infringement seriously. The statement did not explicitly declare the game infringing.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON published the report at 04:34 UTC on September 5, within the fixed evidence window.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report embeds The Tetris Company's statement. This item preserves the company's denial and copyright position without converting it into a confirmed infringement finding.

entries.headline: Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance trailer highlights the Hammer's Boosted Actions
entries.summary: Capcom released a new trailer for the Monster Hunter Wilds expansion Ascendance focused on the Hammer's Boosted Actions. The expansion is due in 2027.
entries.timeNote: Gematsu published the report at 06:00 UTC on September 5, within the fixed evidence window.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report relays Capcom's trailer release and supports the featured weapon and 2027 release window. Base-game platforms are not restated as confirmed expansion platforms.

entries.headline: Licensed 512GB microSD Express card for Nintendo Switch 2 launches October 1
entries.summary: A new 512GB model joins the officially licensed microSD Express card lineup for Nintendo Switch 2. Manufactured by SanDisk, it launches October 1 with a Fire Flower icon, and retailer listings have opened preorders.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON published the report at 07:10 UTC on September 5, within the fixed evidence window.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report supports the capacity, manufacturer, date, and card icon from Nintendo's page update. A price inferred from retailer listings is not included.

entries.headline: Halloween: The Game tops 25,000 concurrent Steam players in early access as reviews remain Mixed
entries.summary: During Deluxe Edition early access, Halloween: The Game exceeded 25,000 concurrent Steam players while user reviews were rated Mixed. AUTOMATON summarizes complaints about clipping, unresponsive inputs, missing tutorials, and performance. The full release is scheduled for September 9 on PC and Xbox Series X|S.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON published the report at 10:10 UTC on September 5, within the fixed evidence window.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report supports the time-specific concurrent-player figure, Steam review status, reported issues, and full-release date and platforms.
